pages:account-settings.title: Account Settings
pages:account-settings.description: A complete account-settings page with persistent navigation, profile and locale editing, personal notification controls, save feedback, and a sustained destructive confirmation.

pages:delete-account.title: Delete Account
pages:delete-account.description: Full-height destructive confirmation screen that lists the consequences and requires the user to type a confirmation word before the delete button enables.

pages:invoice-detail-view.title: Invoice Detail
pages:invoice-detail-view.description: Detailed invoice page with billing address, itemized line items table, subtotal, tax, total, and payment method info with print and download actions.
